steps: Create a free Idle-Empire account at idle-empire.com using Google, Facebook, Twitter, Discord, Steam, or email.
Open the Earn page and complete available tasks: paid surveys, games, videos, and offers.
Points accrue per completed task — check the Earn page daily for new tasks.
When you have enough points, open the shop and choose a reward: gift cards, PayPal cash, or game credits.
Redeem and receive your reward (official pages state delivery within 24 hours).
